tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Annie Christmas roster owner, 1024 by 1024 composition.
Primary request: Create ONE original portrait of the same fictional riverboat heroine established by the approved project miniature design shown in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-annie-christmas-codex/design/annie-christmas-front.png. Preserve that design's identity, skin tone, strong face, knotted red head wrap, earrings, necklaces, cream blouse and palette. This is Annie Christmas herself, not her helper Charlie.
Scene/backdrop: plain charcoal gray background, empty and unadorned.
Subject: powerful adult Black woman with deep warm brown skin, broad strong shoulders, a strong sculpted jaw and cheekbones, straight firm brows, dark brown eyes clearly facing the viewer and a serious resolute expression. Black hair is covered by the approved rust-red fabric head wrap, tied in a prominent knot on top with short folded tails; tiny dark curls beside her ears. Two simple brass hoop earrings. Several chunky natural brown wooden bead necklaces interspersed with turquoise beads over a worn cream collared blouse. Show her upper shoulders and upper chest with the necklace enough to identify the approved design. Retain the reference's practical folk-hero dignity.
Style/medium: distinctly hand-painted premium tabletop MINIATURE bust art, crafted resin sculpture with deliberately sculpted planes and locks, painted shadows and fine restrained brush texture, matte fabric, subtle satin painted skin. Visually match the project's approved collectible miniature craftsmanship. Clearly stylized physical game-character art, not a portrait photograph, beauty shoot or commercial avatar.
Composition/framing: one centered head-and-shoulders bust with upper chest; near-frontal view with at most a slight three-quarter turn and no head tilt. Both eyes unobstructed and readable, eye line near 43 percent of image height. WHOLE head wrap, top knot, folded tails and both earrings visible. Generous blank background around entire headgear: roughly 18 to 20 percent of image height above its highest point, and comfortable side margins around the head. Fit the head, wrap and earrings inside the central 65 percent of the canvas width and keep their silhouette well within an imagined central circular crop. Natural shoulder taper toward lower corners. No hands, river pole, weapons or props beside the head.
Lighting/mood: soft studio key light with gentle fill illuminating both eyes and the planes of her face; calm strength, no dramatic colored FX or obscuring shadows.
Color palette: approved river brown #6B4A30, head-wrap red #B2342C, shirt cream #E0D6C0, bead turquoise #3FA7A0, warm brass earrings, dark hair and natural deep brown skin.
Constraints: one original character portrait, preserve the approved project design's identity and palette. Entire head and wrap, no top or side clipping. No text, letters, symbols, logo, watermark, border, badge, medallion, circular mask, UI, card layout, collage, extra characters, actor likeness or copied commercial artwork. No photographic human skin pores or glamour retouching.

selection_reason: Only generated result; owner identity cues and full square-source headgear remain readable. Composition/style limitations explicitly documented in README.md.
